$description: Hand-written. Interaction states, the same in every mode: the dark wash a fill takes while pressed (the share of black mixed in, in OKLCH), and the opacity of anything disabled. See design/behaviors/interaction-states.md.

pressed-wash.$description: A fill while pressed: this percentage of black mixed into it. color-mix(in oklch, var(--accent-key), var(--black) calc(var(--state-pressed-wash) * 1%)).

disabled-opacity.$description: Anything disabled: a field, a control, a button. It also takes the not-allowed cursor and no hover.
